workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain census tract polygons covering State College in GeoPackage format.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census tract dataset covering State College. Request GeoPackage format and retain the returned artifact metadata for downstream use.

workflow_steps.title: Clip census tracts to State College boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict the retrieved census tract polygons to the supplied State College boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the retrieved census tract GeoPackage layer using the supplied State College boundary GeoPackage. Preserve tract attributes and output a GeoPackage polygon layer.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean elevation by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate mean elevation for each State College census tract using elevation data at 30-meter resolution.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean zonal statistics for each polygon in state_college_census_tracts using input_2 as the elevation raster. Use the 30-meter raster to satisfy the requested resolution and return a CSV table keyed to the census tract attributes. input_1 is an optional coarser raster and must not replace input_2 for this calculation.

requirements.scope: Retrieved dataset must cover State College census tracts.
Both clipping inputs must be supported vector formats for the clipping operation.
The retrieved census tracts and State College boundary must have compatible coordinate reference systems for clipping.
The census tract and boundary geometries must be valid for clipping.
The elevation raster used for zonal statistics must have resolution no coarser than 30 meters.
The elevation raster and clipped census tract polygons must have matching coordinate reference systems for zonal statistics.

agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.

Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.
